Use the provided BURNING VILLAGE reference as the environment reference.

Use the provided final frame from the previous sequence as the starting visual continuity.

The entire scene takes place inside the SAME destroyed burning village.

It is dusk.

Burning buildings surround the village street.

Dense smoke fills the environment.

Orange firelight glows through the smoke.

Ash and embers drift naturally through the air.

No location change.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Grounded realistic human movement.

Realistic physical impact.

Natural cloth, hair, smoke, ash and fire physics.

Dynamic but readable cinematic camera movement.

Keep the action SIMPLE and CLEAR.

Do not create an extended fight.


DIALOGUE LANGUAGE:

ENGLISH ONLY.

"Father?"

No additional dialogue.

No voice-over.

No narration.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No background music.

Riven sees the figure.

Riven calls:

"Father?"

The Mystery Figure does not answer.

Riven realizes that the figure is not her father.

She becomes alert.

The Mystery Figure suddenly rushes directly toward Riven.

Riven reacts too late.

The Mystery Figure delivers ONE powerful attack.

Riven is violently knocked backward onto the ground.

Riven's sword does NOT break.

but its face and identity remain impossible to recognize.


Riven stares at the figure.


For a brief moment,

Riven believes it could be her father.

"Father?"


The Mystery Figure remains silent.


Riven continues looking at it.


She realizes:

this is not her father.


Riven tightens her grip on her intact sword.


Keep this moment brief.


The Mystery Figure suddenly explodes into motion.


It rushes directly toward Riven at extreme speed.


The transition from stillness to attack is sudden and aggressive.


Riven is caught off guard.


She begins to react and starts raising her sword,

but she is too late to establish a proper defensive block.


The Mystery Figure reaches Riven.


ONE POWERFUL IMPACT.


Keep the attack fast and partially obscured by movement and smoke.

Do not clearly explain the exact attack technique.

Do not turn this into a sword duel.

Do not create multiple attacks.


The impact violently throws Riven backward.

hits the dirt,

and slides several feet away.


Riven falls hard onto the ground.

The Mystery Figure remains farther ahead,

partially obscured again by smoke.


Do not continue the fight.


For the final image,

place Riven's INTACT SWORD prominently on the ground in the foreground.


Riven is lying on the ground farther behind it.


The Mystery Figure remains vague and distant through the smoke.


Hold this image briefly.


CUT.

Riven is conscious but stunned.

Riven is lying on the ground.

Riven is NOT standing.

Riven is NOT holding her sword.


Riven's sword is COMPLETELY INTACT.

The sword has NOT broken.

The intact sword is lying on the ground several feet away from Riven.

The sword is beyond Riven's immediate reach.


The Mystery Figure is still present.

The Mystery Figure has NOT been revealed clearly.

The Mystery Figure remains partially obscured by smoke.


There has been only ONE attack.

There has NOT been an extended fight.

Riven has NOT successfully blocked the attack.


The final state must naturally establish:

INTACT SWORD ON THE GROUND IN THE FOREGROUND.

RIVEN ON THE GROUND BEHIND THE SWORD.

MYSTERY FIGURE STILL OBSCURED BY SMOKE.


CUT.


=== MOOD ===

Mysterious.

Threatening.

Sudden.

Violent.

Dark.

Cinematic.

The Mystery Figure should feel unnatural and difficult to understand,

but its true nature must remain unknown.


The key visual progression is:

RIVEN SEES THE MYSTERY FIGURE.

RIVEN SAYS:

"FATHER?"

NO RESPONSE.

RIVEN REALIZES IT IS NOT HER FATHER.

THE MYSTERY FIGURE SUDDENLY RUSHES AT RIVEN.

ONE POWERFUL IMPACT.

RIVEN IS THROWN TO THE GROUND.

HER SWORD REMAINS INTACT.

THE INTACT SWORD SLIDES AWAY.

RIVEN LIES ON THE GROUND.

CUT.、16:9
